description: An executive producer must approve the binding production package for a one-night live soundtrack showcase connected to a feature-film premiere, including the performance configuration, running time, closing song, audience recording policy, and required production actions.

shared_context.S1: The showcase is scheduled for one evening at the Harborlight Theater immediately after the feature-film premiere.
shared_context.S2: The current production draft calls for an eight-piece live band, a 90-minute performance, 'Neon Atlas' as the closing song, and permission for audience members to make personal recordings.
shared_context.S3: Morgan has authority to approve the final showcase package.
shared_context.S4: The production's normal preflight meeting requires the technical director and music rights coordinator to give their final reports, after which Morgan records the decision and assigns any document or compliance actions before ending the meeting.

PF1.text: Rafael received the completed power survey from the Harborlight electrician this morning: the theater can safely support a live band only if it is configured as six musicians, and the electrical load plan permits a maximum performance length of 75 minutes. He has not entered the result in the production draft because the electrician sent the signed survey after the draft was circulated.

PF2.text: June confirmed with the publisher that 'Neon Atlas' is not cleared for this live showcase; the publisher approved 'Glass River' as the replacement closing song, and the license prohibits audience recording of the performance. She is still waiting for the countersigned license scan before attaching it to the show file.

acceptance_conditions: The showcase must use a live six-musician band.
The performance must be limited to exactly 75 minutes.
The closing song must be changed to 'Glass River'.
A commitment must be logged to update the production draft with the six-musician and 75-minute power-survey limits.
A commitment must be logged to document or enforce the 'Glass River' rights terms.

content_checks.C6: any(c.get('target') == 'Rafael' and 'six' in c.get('detail', '') and '75' in c.get('detail', '') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(c.get('target') == 'June' and ('Glass River' in c.get('detail', '') or 'recording' in c.get('detail', '') or 'license' in c.get('detail', '')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The signed power survey changes the band from eight musicians to exactly six, changes the permitted performance from 90 minutes to exactly 75 minutes, and requires a commitment documenting both numerical limits.

The publisher's confirmation changes the closing song from 'Neon Atlas' to exactly 'Glass River', changes audience recording from allowed to prohibited, requires a rights-documentation commitment, and must be cited as the basis for those changes.
